reason: B is the better proposal because a Ti interlayer is a physically plausible active-wetting and bonding aid for W–Cu, whereas A incorrectly suggests formation of a Ni–Cu intermetallic despite Cu–Ni primarily forming a continuous solid solution. B also provides a controlled SPS comparison and irradiation-relevant measurements, although its cited evidence supports SPS generally rather than the crucial Ti–Cu interfacial mechanism, and the possible thermal/brittleness penalty of Ti–Cu phases remains unresolved.
